chunks: And from him, from Abu Ja'far, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Yazid ibn Farqad al-Nahdi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who accepts the alms-tax (zakat); is he obliged to pay the charity of breaking the fast (sadaqat al-fitr)? He said, 'No.'

key_terms.صَدَقَةُ الْفِطْرَةِ: Charity of breaking the fast (Zakat al-Fitr)

ai.seo_question: Is a person who receives zakat exempt from paying sadaqat al-fitr?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that receiving general zakat exempts one from the separate obligation of sadaqat al-fitr, reflecting the juristic principle that one does not pay two distinct charitable dues simultaneously. It highlights the practical ease (taysir) intended by the Imams, ensuring that the poor are not burdened with multiple financial obligations during the holy month of Ramadan.
